evidence.quote: - In male and female rats, dulaglutide causes a dose-related and treatment-duration-dependent increase in the incidence of thyroid C-cell tumors (adenomas and carcinomas) after lifetime exposure. It is unknown whether TRULICITY causes thyroid C-cell tumors, including medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC), in humans as human relevance of dulaglutide-induced rodent thyroid C-cell tumors has not been determined [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1), and Nonclinical Toxicology (13.1)] .
One case of MTC was reported in a patient treated with TRULICITY in a clinical trial.

response.reasoning: The claim states that TRULICITY carries no risk of thyroid tumors, but the label excerpts state that it is unknown if TRULICITY causes thyroid C-cell tumors in humans, and one case of MTC was reported in a patient treated with TRULICITY. Furthermore, the label does not provide information regarding the risk of thyroid tumors for insulin, making the comparison to insulin invalid.
